Class TitanShifter

java.lang.Object
TitanShifter
public class TitanShifter extends Object
Represents a Titan Shifter in the military intelligence tracking system. Contains both an inner class TitanShifter.TitanForm and a static nested class TitanShifter.CoordinatePower.
Author:
Survey Corps HQ

  • Constructor Details

    • TitanShifter

      public TitanShifter(String name, String powerStr, String heightStr, String hostileStr)
      Constructor 1: Initializes the shifter by parsing raw field report intelligence strings.
      Parses the string arguments using wrapper class methods:
      • powerStr parsed to Integer using Integer.valueOf(powerStr)
      • heightStr parsed to Double using Double.valueOf(heightStr)
      • hostileStr parsed to Boolean using Boolean.valueOf(hostileStr)
      Parameters:
      name - shifter name
      powerStr - power level as string
      heightStr - height in meters as string
      hostileStr - hostility as string ("true"/"false")

    • assessCombatReadiness

      public static int[] assessCombatReadiness(Integer power)
      Assesses a shifter's combat readiness via a 4-step boxing/unboxing sequence.

      NOTE: Understand this method properly. This is provided for conceptual understanding only. We have given the code for you to understand how autoboxing, unboxing, re-boxing, and non-reboxing work in sequence.

      1. power++ (Auto-unboxes, increments int, re-boxes into Integer) 2. Integer score = power + (power * 3); (Unboxes, computes, re-boxes) 3. int rawScore = power + (power * 3); (Unboxes, computes, NO re-boxing) 4. Returns new int[]{score, rawScore}
      Parameters:
      power - initial power rating as Integer
      Returns:
      int array with [score, rawScore]
